text: Okay, let's suppose we have our nice, big, beautiful pandas data frame. And we've, this time, read in a lot of data. We didn't just focus on a few days. To select these rows, we do a simple statement that Dave will show you later to create a date time object. And we just put the start date colon end date. And if we just write DF1 bracket SD colon ED, where this is start date and that's end date, then we end up with these three rows. But we want to be more selective. We want to focus on these three rows and these columns. And we need to add one more piece of syntax that indicates these columns. So if we were to execute this statement, DF2 equals DF1, and then this additional syntax, we will end up with this little morsel of data right here in our new data frame.
